rows.role_title: 代表代理 (styled 代表) — interim office under the party rules until a national convention elects a representative (claims only)
rows.text: The party organ reports that at the 中央幹事会 on the morning of the 22nd, following 斉藤鉄夫前代表's joining the new party 「中道改革連合」, the party approved under its rules the appointment of 竹谷とし子氏 as 代表代理 ('竹谷とし子氏を代表代理とする人事を承認した').

rows.role_title: 代表代理 (styled 代表) — interim office under the party rules until a national convention elects a representative (claims only)
rows.text: It adds that the party decided that until a national convention elects a new representative the 代表代理 is called 「代表」, which is why 公明新聞 prints 「代表」 ('党全国大会で新たに代表が選出されるまでの間、代表代理を「代表」と呼称する方針を決定').

rows.role_title: 代表 / 委員長 — representative of 公明党 and, until its December 1994 division, its chair (委員長)
rows.text: It reports that at the committee 斉藤前代表 thanked those who had supported him through more than fifty years with 公明党.
